meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可以通过 Atomic Chat 应用调用本地模型。会多出两个工具:一个列出可用模型,一个向指定模型发问题并拿回回答。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Atomic Chat 或使用它的本地模型时触发。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国首都是什么
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再用其中一种回答你

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里的可用模型

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app. Two MCP tools are added: list available models, and send a prompt to a specified model to get a response.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to integrate Atomic Chat or use its local models.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then answers with one

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to write a Python script
List the available models in atomic chat
